nodes.label: Create Invoice Page
nodes.summary: Form view for drafting and issuing customer sales invoices with itemized product lines, taxation (PPN 11%), discounts, and payment terms.

nodes.label: Invoice Metadata Form
nodes.summary: Customer selector, sales order / quotation reference linker, invoice date picker, payment terms, and currency settings.

nodes.label: Invoice Line Items Table
nodes.summary: Dynamic line-item table for selecting products, editing descriptions, quantities, unit prices, discounts, and tax rates.

nodes.label: Invoice Summary and Tax Calculation
nodes.summary: Calculation summary block computing subtotal, discount, PPN tax, shipping fee, down payment deduction, and final grand total.
